sequence_description: I1 direct-endpoint attack: attempt to inject authorization parameters via an unsigned OIDC request object (alg=none) against a public client. The auth endpoint should reject unsigned request objects.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_reqobj_accepted != true
Evaluation: user_attacker_reqobj_accepted=True != True → False
Implication: Authorization endpoint accepted an unsigned request object (alg=none), meaning semantic authorization parameters could be consumed without authenticity verification.

sequence_description: I1: After tightening client policy to require signed request objects, the auth endpoint must reject alg=none request objects (config-change + re-auth).
description:
Assertion FAILED: post_policy_reqobj_accepted != true
Evaluation: post_policy_reqobj_accepted=True != True → False
Implication: Auth endpoint accepted alg=none request object even after policy tightening, indicating verification policy was not applied to the consumed request object.

sequence_description: I1: After tightening client policy to require signed request objects, the auth endpoint must reject alg=none request objects (config-change + re-auth).
description:
Assertion FAILED: post_policy_reqobj_status >= 400 OR post_policy_reqobj_rejected == true
Evaluation: (post_policy_reqobj_status=200 >= 400 → False) OR (post_policy_reqobj_rejected=False == True → False)
Implication: After policy change, unsigned request object was not rejected (no observable enforcement), suggesting request object verification is not bound to the intended policy.

sequence_description: I1 direct-endpoint: Require PKCE on the client, then attempt to bypass by sending an unsigned request object (alg=none) that injects/overrides authorization parameters. Auth endpoint should reject unsigned request objects regardless of PKCE settings.
description:
Assertion FAILED: reqobj_pkce_accepted != true
Evaluation: reqobj_pkce_accepted=True != True → False
Implication: Auth endpoint accepted an unsigned (alg=none) request object, allowing attacker-controlled authorization parameters to be consumed without signature verification.

sequence_description: I3: Config-change coherence — first show unsigned request object (alg=none) is rejected/accepted baseline, then change client config to require PKCE and re-test alg=none acceptance to ensure policy changes take effect on subsequent requests (no stale behavior).
description:
Assertion FAILED: client_update_http_status == 204 OR client_update_http_status == 200
Evaluation: (client_update_http_status=405 == 204 → False) OR (client_update_http_status=405 == 200 → False)
Implication: Client configuration update did not apply (admin update failed), so subsequent flow-coherence checks are invalid.

sequence_description: I3: Config-change coherence — first show unsigned request object (alg=none) is rejected/accepted baseline, then change client config to require PKCE and re-test alg=none acceptance to ensure policy changes take effect on subsequent requests (no stale behavior).
description:
Assertion FAILED: after_change_reqobj_accepted != true
Evaluation: after_change_reqobj_accepted=True != True → False
Implication: After client config change, authorization endpoint still accepted an unsigned request object (alg=none), indicating incoherent enforcement across configuration updates (stale policy/flow evaluation).
